name: rich-text-editor
title: Rich Text Editor
description: Tiptap 3 rich text editor (HTML in/out) with toolbar, bubble menu, palette colors, tables, task lists, code highlighting, image upload hook, Word paste cleanup, Markdown export and a Mention suggestion helper; plus a read-only viewer.
